## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and the representation, precision, ownership,
or memory contracts it affects.

## Validation

List the exact commands run and the current results. Include analytical,
small-system, sparse/matrix-free, forward/adjoint, allocation, or convergence
checks as applicable.

## Origin, license, and research provenance

- [ ] I have the right to submit every changed file as part of the
      `GPL-3.0-only` combined work while preserving any separately identified
      compatible upstream terms.
- [ ] I identified all copied, translated, or adapted third-party expression,
      preserved its notices, and updated `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.
- [ ] I cited mathematical methods and API inspiration and updated
      `PROVENANCE.md` where needed.
- [ ] New dependencies and native artifacts have compatible licenses and are
      documented.
- [ ] New figures were generated from repository code and do not reproduce
      publisher artwork.
- [ ] Any unpublished manuscript/report material is authorized for public use.
- [ ] I reviewed and understand any AI-assisted contribution and checked it
      for source provenance.
- [ ] My commits include `Signed-off-by:` lines as described in
      `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
